description: This file defines a PHP trait called AttendanceRecordPermissionTrait that provides permission checking functionality for attendance records within the OrangeHRM system. It includes a method to ensure that the current user has access to a specific attendance record, throwing exceptions if access is denied or if used improperly. The trait relies on other components such as UserRoleManagerTrait, Endpoint, and entity classes like AttendanceRecord and Employee.

methods.name: checkAttendanceRecordAccessible
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to the specified attendance record. Throws a ForbiddenException if access is denied or a LogicException if used outside of an Endpoint context.
